name: tg-media-down-bot
description: Telegram bot that turns a message link into the file behind it, and transfers to PikPak. Finish setup inside Telegram with /setup.

ADMIN_USER_IDS.description: Optional. Leave blank: the bot prints a claim code to its log, and sending /claim <code> in Telegram makes you the admin with no second deploy. Set it only if you would rather skip that step.

HTTP_ENABLED.description: Serve the PikPak file endpoint and the Telegram Mini App login page.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public HTTPS address of this deployment, for example https://my-bot.example.com. Leave blank on platforms that export it themselves.

DEFAULT_MODE.description: Where files go by default: telegram, local or pikpak.
